notes.title: Achievements added to Hidden Lands!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We've been in silent mode for a while now. 
Publishing Hidden Lands for free on Steam for us was a great and new experience for us.
As a team we think this was a huge success and the first of many games to come.

As you might know Hidden Lands is also available for free on Google Play and the Appstore and every new feature we make we usually have to make it for all the platforms so it makes everything a bit slowly.

Nevertheless, we are reading your reviews and suggestions and we plan to slowly improve our little spot the difference game so, as the title says, now there's a bunch of achievements to unlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39590079/8900c3f6b03f7b91858b89f72b36ae6c0fa66257.png[/img]

Please let us know in the comments what new feature you would like to see next.
Also, would you pay as a way of support our jobs, for new themes and collections? 

Thanks again for playing and we send you a huge (and safe) virtual hug!
